scripts.build:desktop: tsc -p packages/desktop && npm run build:fixtures && npm run build:renderer
scripts.build:fixtures: mkdir -p packages/desktop/dist/tests/fixtures && cp packages/desktop/tests/fixtures/* packages/desktop/dist/tests/fixtures/ && chmod +x packages/desktop/dist/tests/fixtures/*.sh
scripts.build:renderer: tsc -p packages/desktop/tsconfig.renderer.json && cp packages/desktop/src/renderer/index.html packages/desktop/dist/src/renderer/index.html && cp packages/desktop/src/renderer/sort.html packages/desktop/dist/src/renderer/sort.html && cp packages/desktop/src/renderer/projects.html packages/desktop/dist/src/renderer/projects.html && cp packages/desktop/src/renderer/top-three.html packages/desktop/dist/src/renderer/top-three.html
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && tsc -p packages/desktop --noEmit && tsc -p packages/desktop/tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && TZ=America/New_York playwright test
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --projectDir packages/desktop --config electron-builder.yml --config.electronVersion=$(node -p "require('electron/package.json').version") --publish never
